vuln_statements.explanation: This is the vulnerable function nfsd4_add_rdaccess_to_wrdeleg() identified in the root cause. The function improperly manages nfsd_file references by overwriting fp->fi pointers without proper reference handling. When this function modifies the file pointer association for read delegations on write delegations, it fails to properly increment/decrement reference counts before overwriting, leading to potential use-after-free or double-free vulnerabilities in the cleanup path shown in put_deleg_file().
